subject: soc-rt-dy
title: SOC.RT.DY.------PHY.U.P.
description: Diagram in SD(SY)-25 (Spectacle-Diversion Syndrome, Level One) accompanying Braxton's opening of the hippie-movement analysis: 'the principles which manifest themselves in each spectacle-diversion sequence, and how people relate to what this sequence is supposed to mean — that clarifies the real fabric of American culture.' (C)SOC-RT-DY (the concept of social reality dynamics) is crossed with PHY-U-P (physical universe particulars): the question is what social-reality-dynamics produces when crossed with physical-universe-particulars in a culture where the diversion sequence determines self-perception. POL-P (political policies) branches from the main line and leads to CN-INFO (controlled information), which carries PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and (R)TM (the reality of terminology—or terms of a definition). From (R)TM the chain runs to (R)INT (the reality of intention), then to CUL-INFO-B (culture-information basis), which ends in TRS (transition).
